rule: WM-G1: black point L* 11-14; toe on L* only (a*, b* kept), piecewise linear through the points below; nothing at L* 30 or above changes; no exposure change

bp_l1.rule: per column: the line's peak row; the soffit = median of rows peak-5..peak-3; rows peak-2..peak+2 brighter than it by more than 2 L* move to it (fully at +6); columns whose peak is not 4 L* over both the soffit and the wall below are left alone

derived_assets: grade every asset derived from this plate with: python3 grade_plate.py apply <in> <out> plate-grade.json
